card.text: Small moon that trails Tethys along its orbit around Saturn.

introduction.text: Calypso's surface is one of the most reflective in the solar system. Loose material smooths its overlapping craters.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces shading; terrain in cast shadows is left empty.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 10.7 km sphere from the Cassini shape; small craters are not resolved.
